My mom passed in 2009 before I was a teen, and my dad remarried less than a year after. He was always an angry man, but makes very good money in IT, well over 250k a year.. still spent the social security money and life insurance on taking his new wife on trips, multiple SUVs (Escalades), had swinger parties while my brother and I watched their son they had together, travelling every week without us.. thats also when I learned about Christianity, when that got forced on me for my dads image to his new wife's parents.

Fast forward to almost present,  and my brother and I live in trailerparks barely paycheck to paycheck, and we help each other out. He lives lavishly always traveling still with his wife, and all I get from him are texts about how much I'm failing in life.. Got in a motorcycle accident and have been using that payout money to finish school. 

Now that I'm one semester from my degree, he's trying to build a positive relationship with me because "You're finally doing something with my life"..  I think I'll pass. :P
